verse.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding. Seek his will in all you do, and he will show you which path to take.

video.title: Make Your Path Straight | Proverbs 3:5–6 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Leading a family well doesn't mean having every answer figured out before you take the next step — it means trusting the God who already sees the whole path. When you're stuck deciding how to discipline, provide, or guide your kids, this verse is permission to stop white-knuckling control and instead ask God for direction, then take the next faithful step. A dad who visibly leans on God, rather than pretending he's got it all together, teaches his kids the most important lesson of all: real strength is trusting the One who's stronger than you.
